name: Vidya Classes
about: A coaching institute in Pune for classes 9–12 and entrance exams, founded in 2009 by Sunanda Joshi, a former physics teacher.

decisions.question: What do we do about AI tutors?

options.label: Build AI into every class
options.consequence: Students practise with AI; teachers see where each one struggles.

options.label: Retrain teachers as mentors
options.consequence: AI explains; teachers mentor small groups and talk to parents.

ban.question: AI is banned in class. What happens to the teachers?

cut.label: Cut staff to cut fees
cut.consequence: Compete with the free AI apps on price: fewer teachers, cheaper fees.

retrain.label: Make teachers mentors
retrain.consequence: No AI in class; teachers coach small groups and keep parents close.

build.question: AI now does the explaining. What happens to the teachers?

cut.label: Let AI teach, cut staff
cut.consequence: AI covers the explaining, so fewer teachers are needed and fees fall.

retrain.label: Retrain teachers as mentors
retrain.consequence: AI explains; teachers mentor small groups and talk to parents.

luck.headline: A free AI tutor app goes viral
A big coaching chain collapses; parents look for a trusted name
A Vidya student tops the state exam

endings.label: Pune's most trusted
endings.line: Mentors who know every student. Every classroom full.
glimpse: Monday morning, 2036. Every *desk* is taken before seven.
Monday morning, 2036. Sunanda's mentors know each student by *name*.

endings.label: Lean and growing
endings.line: AI does the explaining. Fewer teachers, more students.
glimpse: Monday morning, 2036. One teacher runs a room of *sixty*.
Monday morning, 2036. Fees are the *lowest* in Pune.

endings.label: Empty classrooms
endings.line: The rooms emptied one by one. Sunanda still teaches the dawn batch.
glimpse: Monday morning, 2036. The 6 a.m. *batch*: three students.
Monday morning, 2036. Sunanda picks up the chalk and starts *again*.

endings.label: Smaller, still standing
endings.line: Loyal families stayed. Half the rooms are empty.
glimpse: Monday morning, 2036. The loyal *families* still come.
Monday morning, 2036. Half the rooms are *quiet*.
